description: The fixed set of upgrade-script steps.

items.description: Replace references to content ID `from` with `to`.
Remove copies of and picks for content `id`.
Move an input field's saved value from `from` to `to`.
Drop an input field's saved value.
Give an input field a value (a formula over the old character) where it has none.
Map an input field's old values to new ones.
Rename a per-copy state key on copies of content type `type`.
Replace a picked option `from` of choice `choice` (on `owner`, or the rules) with `to`, or remove the pick when `to` is absent.
Mark a new required choice on `owner` (or the rules) as pending for the player.
Rewrite references to content type `from` in a character's homebrew to `to`.
Move item field `from` to `to` on homebrew items of content type `type`, and in their formulas.
Drop item field `field` from homebrew items of content type `type`.
Map item field `field`'s old values to new ones on homebrew items of content type `type`.
Rewrite tag `from` to `to` in a character's homebrew and in saved tag sets.
Rewrite references to action `from` in a character's homebrew to `to`.
Rename the first entry holding `item` to the item's standard copy ID, unless an entry has it already.
